immutable_R3_basis.immutability_rule: R3 result, captures, terminal, evaluation and consumed admission are historical evidence and must not be rewritten, replayed or relabeled as a new attempt.

primary_owned_defect: Landing discovery, structured endpoint discovery and document fetch share one per-attempt network allowance, so a natural multi-route attempt can exhaust its allowance after qualifying locators but before fetching a document body.
Pre-request local budget stops return response=None and are stored in the cross-attempt document cache, so a later slot with its own allowance can inherit a failure that never reached the network.
The previous deterministic proof bypassed this natural route-to-document topology and did not mutate cross-slot negative-cache poisoning.
separate_operational_gaps: Dell and Micron issuer-IR landing transport was not reliable in R3.
external_site_search is declared but not operationally configured.
A governed current market snapshot was unavailable.
decision_evidence.causal_boundary: Operational gaps may still limit final recall, but they cannot explain 229 qualified locator receipts followed by zero document requests. Provider purchase or source-claim reduction cannot be evaluated honestly until the owned path can fetch at least one qualified body under the fixed budget.

options.reason: It removes a proven project defect without spending network or model calls and creates a valid baseline for the later provider/product decision.
A new provider would still enter the same broken document-fetch and cache path, so present evidence cannot establish necessity, sufficiency or value for money.
Reducing the product promise now would conceal a project-owned false gap rather than establish the true public-source ceiling.
These actions weaken the frozen stop rule or spend around a deterministic defect without establishing source quality.

requirements: Retain the global 16-network-call ceiling and reserve a protected document-fetch opportunity once a locator passes the qualified-locator gate.
Separate discovery/index requests from the document-fetch opportunity in scheduling semantics without hiding either class from the same global budget.
Never write a pre-request local cancellation, global budget stop or slot-attempt reservation stop into a cross-attempt document cache.
Represent captured remote success, captured remote failure, parser outcome and attempt-local stop as distinct typed cache or lineage states.
Replay the immutable R3 request/response topology and exercise the real adapter path instead of returning candidates directly from a fake scheduler.
Cover landing-to-feed/sitemap/structured-route-to-document flow, locator permutation, allowance permutation and cross-slot cache-poison mutations.
Run DELL, MU and NVDA full-fake regression with numeric, identity, currentness, relationship and lineage mutations.
Preserve R3 artifacts byte-for-byte and perform zero network, model, provider, admission or live calls.
selected_zero_call_package.proof_failure_rule: If the protected-fetch and attempt-local-cache invariants cannot be proven under the fixed 16-call ceiling, stop S1-08 implementation and return to a provider acquisition or product source-claim decision. Do not execute live.

provider_and_product_scope_disposition.required_later_decision: A separate owner decision must evaluate P3A proof, residual provider gaps, product source claim and whether the no-R4 stop rule is amended before any new DELL attempt can be named, admitted or executed.

explicitly_not_authorized: R4 or any additional DELL live attempt
budget increase, retry or Evidence Gate relaxation

product_capability_delta: No Agentic Search or research-product capability was added. P3 only selects the next bounded repair/proof and prevents premature provider purchase or product-scope reduction.
decision_boundary: This decision authorizes one zero-call P3A implementation-and-proof package only. It does not repair the Runtime, prove candidate quality, close S1-08, amend no-R4, purchase a provider, shrink the product claim or authorize a new live attempt.
